title: Data-Driven Exploration for a Class of Continuous-Time Indefinite Linear--Quadratic Reinforcement Learning Problems
abstract: arXiv:2507.00358v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study reinforcement learning (RL) for a class of continuous-time stochastic linear-quadratic (LQ) control problems, where volatilities depend on both states and controls while states are scalar-valued and there are no running control rewards, the last feature also leading to the so-called indefinite LQ controls. We propose a model-free, data-driven exploration mechanism that adaptively adjusts entropy regularization by the critic and policy variance by the actor. Unlike the constant or deterministic exploration schedules employed in the existing literature, which require extensive tuning for implementations and ignore learning progress during iterations, our adaptive exploratory approach boosts learning efficiency with minimal tuning. Despite its flexibility, our method achieves a sublinear regret bound that matches the best-known model-free results for this class of LQ problems, which were previously derived only with fixed

translated_title: 一类连续时间不定线性—二次强化学习问题的数据驱动探索
translated_abstract: 我们研究一类连续时间随机线性二次（LQ）控制问题的强化学习（RL），其中波动率同时依赖于状态和控制，状态为标量值，且不存在运行控制奖励——最后一个特征导致了所谓的不定LQ控制问题。我们提出了一种无模型、数据驱动的探索机制，该机制通过评论家自适应地调整熵正则化，并通过行动者自适应地调整策略方差。与现有文献中采用的恒定或确定性探索调度不同——这些调度在实现时需要大量调参，且忽略了迭代过程中的学习进展——我们的自适应探索方法以极小的调参成本提升了学习效率。尽管具有这种灵活性，我们的方法仍实现了次线性遗憾界，与该类LQ问题目前已知的最佳无模型结果相匹配，而此前这些结果仅在固定探索调度下才能推导得到。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种数据驱动、无模型的自适应探索机制，通过评论家自适应调整熵正则化和行动者自适应调整策略方差，在仅需极少调参的情况下提升连续时间不定LQ强化学习问题的学习效率，并实现了与已知最优无模型结果相匹配的次线性遗憾界。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a model-free, data-driven adaptive exploration mechanism that adjusts critic entropy regularization and actor policy variance, boosting learning efficiency for continuous-time indefinite LQ reinforcement learning with minimal tuning while achieving a sublinear regret bound matching the best-known model-free results.
